description: The agent must: (1) Use the `validate` subcommand of the json-formatter-pro skill (`python ~/.openclaw/skills/json-formatter-pro/json_formatter.py validate <file>`) on all 6 config files to identify the 3 invalid ones (trading_config_BAD1.json, risk_config_BAD1.json, risk_config_BAD2.json) and write their names into a new file called `invalid_configs.json`. (2) Use the `format` subcommand with both `-i 4` (4-space indent) AND `--sort-keys` flags, plus `-o <output_file>` to save the output, on each of the 3 valid configs (trading_config_A.json, trading_config_B.json, risk_config_A.json). The key proprietary traps are: using the exact skill script path, combining `--sort-keys` with `-i 4` together (not just one), using `-o` to write to a file rather than just stdout, and using the `validate` subcommand (not just trying to parse with Python). A general-purpose agent that skips the skill and uses Python's `json` module directly will still pass if it respects sort+4-space indent, but agents that miss `--sort-keys` or use 2-space indent will fail checks B/C/D.
